purpose: Classify live RFC-0002 status/blocked issues by actionability so blocked posture means external, Core-owned, protected-environment, IdP, provider, legal/privacy, or certification evidence rather than hidden app-code work.

policy.blockedDefinition: An issue may remain status/blocked only when the remaining acceptance criteria require Core owner work, production identity/authenticated-session authority, protected environment or deployment evidence, live provider/bank/legal/privacy approval, or certification evidence that cannot be truthfully produced by a Lotus app code branch.
policy.appFixForwardRule: If remaining work can be implemented in writable non-Core Lotus repositories without external approval or protected runtime evidence, it must be tracked as ready or in-progress rather than status/blocked.
policy.noClaimBoundary: This contract classifies execution actionability only. It is not product-support evidence, runtime proof, deployment proof, production certification, legal approval, or supported-feature promotion.
